pages.text: $(thing)Cool-season crops$() grow from 0-5 °C and tolerate light frost. Sow them in early spring, as soon as the ground thaws:$(br2)$(li)Alfalfa$(li)Barley$(li)Beetroot$(li)Cabbage$(li)Carrot

$(thing)Warm-season crops$() need 10 °C or more and die in frost. Sow them after the last frost, in late spring or early summer:$(br2)$(li)Common Bean$(li)Cotton$(li)Maize$(li)Onion$(li)Peanut$(li)Potato$(li)Rice
$(thing)Very hardy crops$() survive -10 °C or colder and can be sown in autumn to overwinter:$(br2)$(li)Alfalfa$(li)Barley$(li)Common Wheat$(li)Durum Wheat$(li)Garlic$(li)Red Clover$(li)Rye
Check the date with /tilth calendar, and frosts with /tilth climate.
